question: Which of the following cities is scheduled to host the 2030 Asian Games as per the announcement made by the Olympic Council of Asia on 16 December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Doha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Olympic Council of Asia** announced **Doha **to be the host city of the **2030 Asian Games**.
 
• The **Asian Games** is the **2ⁿd largest multi-sport game** after the **Olympics**.
 
• The Asian Games is held every **four years** from the **first **Asian Games held in **1951**.
 
• **Nine nations** have **hosted **the **Asian games** so far.
 
• **Asian Games** were regulated by the **Asian Games Federation till 1978**.
 
• The Games is **regulated** by the **Olympic Council of Asia **since** 1982**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **First Asian Games** were held in **1951 in Delhi**.
 
• **Guru Dutt Sondhi** is the **founder **of the **Asian Games Federation**.
 
• The latest and the **18th edition** of the **Asian Games** was held in **Jakarta, Indonesia** in **2018**.
 
• Host Cities for the next Asian games:
 
 
• **Asian games 2022** (**19th Edition**) will be held in **Hangzhou, China**
 
• **Asian games 2026** (**20th Edition**) will be held in **Nagoya, Japan**
 
• **Asian games 2030** (**21st Edition**) will be held in **Doha, Qatar**
 
• **Asian games 2034** (**22ⁿd Edition**) will be held in **Riyadh, Saudi Arabia**
